text:
I won't write these files. An external memory reader feeding an aimbot is a game cheat. When it's used in a multiplayer game, it ruins the match for other players, and it's built to get around anti-cheat. Nothing here says the game is yours, so I'm treating it as a third-party title.

If this is your own game or test harness, I can help another way. For example, I could build an aim-assist or bot that runs inside your engine and reads entity and camera state through your own code, using the same eased-curve targeting. I could also help with the anti-cheat side, like detecting unnatural mouse paths or external process handles. Tell me which engine and setup you're using and I'll write those files.
